using System;
using System.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Tsavorite.core.Tests
{
    public class TsavoriteKVTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Constructor_WhenBothCheckpointDirAndCheckpointManagerSpecified_LogsInformationMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteKV<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>, DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>>>>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("CheckpointManager and CheckpointDir specified, ignoring CheckpointDir")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ));

            var kvSettings = new KVSettings<int, int>()
            {
                loggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>(MockBehavior.Strict).Object,
                logger = loggerMock.Object,
                ReadCacheEnabled = false
            };
            kvSettings.SetCheckpointSettings(new CheckpointSettings()
            {
                CheckpointDir = "some/dir",
                CheckpointManager = new Mock<ICheckpointManager>().Object
            });

            var storeFunctions = new EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>();
            Func<AllocatorSettings, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>, DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>> allocatorFactory = 
                (settings, funcs) => new DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>(settings, funcs);

            // Act
            var tsavorite = new TsavoriteKV<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>, DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>>(
                kvSettings, storeFunctions, allocatorFactory);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("CheckpointManager and CheckpointDir specified, ignoring CheckpointDir")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ), Times.Once);
        }

        public void Constructor_WhenCheckpointDirNull_LogsNothing()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteKV<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>, DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>>>>(MockBehavior.Strict);
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

            var kvSettings = new KVSettings<int, int>()
            {
                loggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>(MockBehavior.Strict).Object,

                ReadCacheEnabled = false
            };

                CheckpointDir = null,

            });

            var storeFunctions = new EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>();
            Func<AllocatorSettings, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>, DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>> allocatorFactory = 
                (settings, funcs) => new DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>(settings, funcs);

            // Act
            var tsavorite = new TsavoriteKV<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>, DefaultAllocator<int, int, EmptyStoreFunctions<int, int>>>(
                kvSettings, storeFunctions, allocatorFactory);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                It.IsAny<LogLevel>(),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
            ), Times.Never);
        }

        public void Constructor_WhenCheckpointManagerNull_LogsNothing()
        {
            // Arrange

        {

            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddLogging();
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var loggerProvider = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILoggerProvider>();
            
            var kvSettings = new KVSettings<int, int>()
            {
                loggerFactory = loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                ReadCacheEnabled = false
            };
            kvSettings.SetCheckpointSettings(new CheckpointSettings()
            {
                CheckpointDir = "some/dir",
                CheckpointManager = Mock.Of<ICheckpointManager>()
            });

            var storeFunctions = Mock.Of<IStoreFunctions<int, int>>();
            Func<AllocatorSettings, IStoreFunctions<int, int>, IAllocator<int, int, IStoreFunctions<int, int>>> allocatorFactory = 
                (settings, funcs) => Mock.Of<IAllocator<int, int, IStoreFunctions<int, int>>>();

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Record.Exception(() => new TsavoriteKV<int, int, IStoreFunctions<int, int>, IAllocator<int, int, IStoreFunctions<int, int>>>(

            Assert.Null(exception);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
